I had six zirconia crowns done at this clinic, perfectly adapted to my existing implants, and the quality is outstanding. Several months have passed, and everything still feels perfect — no discomfort, no food getting stuck, no issues at all.
After a very bad experience with crowns made in Turkey, I finally understand how important true quality is. This clinic is not cheap, but the work is done at the same professional level as in Switzerland. My dentist at home confirmed that the results are excellent and of the highest standard.
The clinic is spotless, the atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and the staff is incredibly kind and professional. The doctor was gentle, caring, and made me feel completely safe throughout the treatment.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone who values their health.
Thank you for the excellent care — I will definitely come back.

The treatment and environment itself is very good, staff are very friendly and accommodating, however, in my opinion, it seems that in case if foreigners the goal is to get as much money as possible.

I went there specifically for teeth cleaning. They do unnecessary scan (why do it for teeth cleaning?) and told me I need to do 4 fillings.

Upon return to Germany I went immediately to my regular dentist and I was told my teeth are fine and do not require fillings at the moment, except for one which he recommended to do later due to wearing Invisalign.

If you have money or insurance pays, you can go there. Seems like more of a clinic expats who don’t mind spending cash. Maybe good place for Americans but as a European no.

Anyways thanks 2 Staff for being accommodating :)

This is the third time I have returned to Paya Clinic, and I cannot imagine going anywhere else for dental treatment.

The service is outstanding, the care is remarkable, and the results are beautiful. I recommend Paya Dental Clinic wholeheartedly.

After years of visiting many different dental clinics, I can honestly say that I have never encountered a team as professional, caring, and gentle as the one at Paya.

Everything began with the appointment scheduling process. The communication was fast, efficient, friendly, and highly professional. Throughout a long and complex series of treatments, everything ran like clockwork. One doctor followed another seamlessly, I never waited even a minute, and every appointment was perfectly organized and timed.

The doctors are among the most skilled professionals I have ever met, but what impressed me most was their extraordinary level of care and gentleness. Throughout every procedure, I felt genuinely seen and cared for. Whenever there was a potentially uncomfortable or painful step, someone would check on me, make sure I was okay, explain exactly what was happening, and do everything possible to keep me comfortable. Sometimes they would even hold my hand during difficult moments.

Every detail was checked, rechecked, and reviewed multiple times. It was clear that nothing was left to chance. The doctors regularly consulted with one another, discussed options, and explained everything thoroughly, giving me complete confidence that I was receiving the highest standard of care.

Under the leadership of Dr. Joy, the clinic reflects an exceptional combination of medical excellence and genuine compassion. You can feel the attention to detail, the commitment to quality, and the deep care for every patient who walks through the door.

For anyone who, like me, is afraid of dental procedures but refuses to compromise on quality, professionalism, or results, this is the place.
